findings.title: Factor-of-two error in the local Euler linearization and its derived wave system
findings.demonstration: Correct divergence linearization is partial_mu(rho*g^{mu nu}*partial_nu psi)=0. Since sqrt|det g|=c, Box_g psi=-Q(log(rho/c),psi). Paper gives -1/2. For gamma=2,k0=1/2,s=t+1,rho=1/s,v=(x/s,0),phi=-x^2/(2s)+log(s), all local Euler assumptions hold; paper (2.2) residual=1/(4*s^2), paper (3.7) w residual=1/(8*s^(3/2)).
findings.counterexample_scope: Local smooth irrotational Euler identities only. Not a counterexample satisfying the main theorem's global rarefaction data ansatz.

independent_acceptance.reasoning: Re-derived the Euler Hessian and divergence-form linearization: sqrt(abs(det g))=c in 2+1 dimensions gives Box_g psi=-Q(log(rho/c),psi), with coefficient 1. The report's exact positive-density, irrotational gamma=2 solution satisfies the local hypotheses; residuals 1/(4s^2) and 1/(8s^(3/2)) are correct. Equations (3.7) feed zero/higher-order energy estimates and bootstrap closure, supporting Major. The example does not claim to satisfy all main-theorem initial data; null-form preservation is counterevidence to theorem falsity, not a reason to downgrade the demonstrated core derivation. Full proof repair and journal-final equivalence remain unverified.
